creator: Codex-authored indexed pixel drawings for Edgefall
reference: Original Quay Watch / Breakwater / Kestrel designs; shared Edgefall native-pixel scale and palette discipline, no sampled third-party pixels.
notes: Kestrel is an original compact teal amphibious tractor with warm tread rollers, slab armor and a separate eight-direction turret.
Chassis, tread phase, turret and hatch/crew are separate native layers. Turret headings follow world aim and do not inherit hull facing.
Boarding and exit hatch acting sample the accepted 12/8-tick seat action. The simulation alone transfers ownership and places the occupant.

Crew revision: seven boarding and seven ordinary exit drawings show boots, knees, hands, jacket and head crossing the hatch. The last closed/open exposure coincides with the existing seat-transfer marker. The operative atlas owns emergency recovery at the accepted safe root; no duplicated crew remains on the wreck.

Suspension revision: eight literal track phases, also drawn extended, run separately from the hull. Solver-owned ground velocity advances the tread clock; it excludes support carry, holds in flight and stays at the accepted phase when stopped. Hull drawings keep the turret hardpoint fixed while nose, rear and exposed springs articulate through drive, accepted launch/rise/apex/fall and light/heavy impact. Eight additional kick drawings shorten each barrel by two native pixels for the tick after release, followed by its retained one-pixel recovery. Accepted release sockets and all crew/seat/wreck drawings remain unchanged. Human weight/readability review remains pending.
